```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
display(pd.read_csv('results/comparison.csv'))
display(json.load(open('results/diagnostics.json')))
display(json.load(open('results/run-identity.json')))
```

This is numerical solution verification of one liquid state with the imposed
IAPWS self-ionization constant. The source release R11-07(2019), Eqs. 1–4 and
Tables 1–3, conditions, source constant and solvent mass are retained in
`inputs/cases/water-self-ionization/source/source.json`. The native declaration
uses the selected Held packet with only water's admitted molar mass replaced
by that source value. The run identity preserves the original packet mass,
admitted source mass, source hashes and loaded native library identity.
The diagnostics retain actual phase amount, every species amount, composition,
density, pressure, slope and native reference status, cause and terminal values.

The table compares the raw reaction contraction, inventory, charge/ion equality,
normalization and pressure defects with their accepted numerical tolerances.
Boolean requirements use a zero defect for satisfaction and a zero tolerance.
The reaction check contracts the three native raw Chemical rows with the
source stoichiometry. Their conserved-inventory and electrical multipliers
cancel. The reader checks row identity and exact agreement between the native
point evaluation and retained residuals; classified trace-weighted rows remain
separate in the diagnostics. Terminal change is a local reference-convergence
estimate, not a bound on source uncertainty. Ion masses retain their packet
values, so the inventory check makes no independent exact physical mass claim.

Source molalities, solved source activities and the independent activity product
remain unavailable pending Engine #793. The imposed constant and transformed
reaction residual cannot supply that missing verification. Source density is
provenance for the input constant, not an EOS density target. Historical amounts
remain historical under a different parameter identity. This single state
establishes neither the general IAPWS correlation nor experimental speciation,
pH, calorics or global stability. Separate scalar checks are displayed in a
table without an interpolated curve. Independent delivered review and manuscript
promotion remain open.
